findings.text: the merge-head row is relabelled "reload test and nine importing files" but gate/repair-head.log at 3b58fd2f78 ran the reload test plus only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py (62 = 58 + 4); the nine-file set reads 60 without the reload test and 64 with it, and no nine-file log exists at that revision, so the row records an arm that was not run and the paragraph at :128 repeats it.

assert reloader.source_root == reloader._station.source_root compares two sides that move together, because __init__ assigns the left from the right (session_host.py:382), so the line holds whatever the constructor does and cannot fail on the regression it appears to guard; the delegation guard is the preceding line, which does fail in neg-refactor.log.

StationReloader is constructed with a runtime root only and reads the carried image identity and source root from os.environ, so a host run with an explicit environ (the public run(environ=...) argument) ignores it, and the new positive arm at tests/test_a_session_host_reloads_onto_current_code.py:434 passes only while RECKON_FOLLOWER_SOURCE_ROOT is absent from the real process environment.

the wrapper drives StationReloader through its private members (_reload_owed, _deferred_proof_at, _arm_deferred_proof at :432 and :438, _replace at :445) rather than through a published step, so a refactor inside the owner silently changes the host's deferral and retry schedule.
